_docs: Tier policy (v2) read by vendor/mogui/scripts/dispatch-gate and scripts/orchestration.py. Entries are model families, not versioned ids: an entry covers a model named exactly like it or containing it as a '-'-separated part, so a new model version needs no edit here. The gate and the ledger see the family; Orca gets the version the Claude Code CLI resolves that family to at dispatch time. A model that no entry covers cannot be dispatched. 'top' is capped at 2 workers per 24 hours; pass --tier-override REASON to exceed it.
